integrationPrinciple: Preserve existing GPS + quiz tasks; introduce optional AR moments as clearly marked new steps, with GPS fallback and safe screen-position overlays if camera tracking is unreliable.
arAltitudePolicy: Do not use legacy Unity altitude as absolute vertical AR alignment. Use user placement, visual alignment or field-verified geospatial anchor only.

proposals.title: Пронађи торањ
proposals.interaction: Player points the camera toward City Hall; a translucent outline or visual guide highlights the tower, then a short historical year prompt appears.

proposals.title: Боје Коњовића
proposals.interaction: AR color cards float over the screen; player matches a palette concept inspired by the painter, without requiring copyrighted painting images.

proposals.title: Позорница у простору
proposals.interaction: At the theater façade, player places a small virtual stage frame and reveals a mini question about the theater history.

proposals.title: Стихови око споменика
proposals.interaction: Player manually places floating text fragments near the monument and reorders them; the actual quoted text must be selected during editorial review.

proposals.title: Сомборски неми филм
proposals.interaction: Place a stylized silent-film frame over the camera view, then answer a question about Ernest Bošnjak.

reviewRule: No proposed AR task changes current scoring, route or mission gating until explicitly accepted and tested.
